question_record.context: As an addition to the Kekeo malware investigation on host `vnevado-win10b`, there was also a suspicious sequence of exploration activities identified. Such windows commands can be leveraged by attackers for reconnaissance and to coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine. We need to further analyze this by identifying the specific process that performed these reconnaissance activities.
question_record.question: Can you identify the process that executed the suspicious sequence of exploration activities?
solution: An active 'Kekeo' malware was detected running the process `rubeus.exe`.
PsExec was used to launch a command on a remote device, running the process `net.exe`.
A suspicious sequence of exploration activities was detected, with the command line process `whoami.exe` executed at `2024-06-27t14:32:19.285352z` with Process ID `6512`.

106.name: An active 'Kekeo' malware was detected
106.description:
Malware and unwanted software are undesirable applications that perform annoying, disruptive, or harmful actions on affected machines. Some of these undesirable applications can replicate and spread from one machine to another. Others are able to receive commands from remote attackers and perform activities associated with cyber attacks.

A malware is considered active if it is found running on the machine or it already has persistence mechanisms in place. Active malware detections are assigned higher severity ratings.

Because this malware was active, take precautionary measures and check for residual signs of infection.

95.name: PsExec launched a command on a remote device
95.description: PsExec was used to launch a command on a remote device. PsExec is a tool used to launch programs on remote, or local devices. An attacker might be leveraging this tool to launch malicious commands to a remote device and move laterally in the organization.

77.name: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities
77.description: A process called a set of windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers in order to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning
